thread:
kai: seeing intermittent connection failures to headless service model-backend.svc.cluster.local from edge pods in eu-west. CoreDNS returns IPs but TCP hangs/RESETs. Only fixed after kube-proxy restart on node. anyone seen this before?
amy: yup, saw similar yesterday during a big checkpoint push to S3 :grimacing: thought it was conntrack saturation.
pranav: can you run `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` and `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` on a problematic node?
kai: ran them: `conntrack count=65530`, `nf_conntrack_max=65536` — that looks... close to full. also `ss -tn state syn-recv` shows lots of SYN_RECV entries.
lisa: endpoint-slice controller logs show a few hundred endpoint deletions/creations around the same timestamps. health probes failing maybe because source ports get reused?
kai: tcpdump shows many SYNs from pod IPs with no reply, then retransmits, then RSTs. Looks like NAT port exhaustion on the node egress path.
infra-bot: alert: kube-proxy restart (eu-west-1-nodex) at 2025-10-20T12:34:10Z (rolling).
amy: kube-proxy restarts can exacerbate orphan conntrack entries, but the counts suggest we hit nf_conntrack_max first.
pranav: mitigation suggestions: bump `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` to 262144, shrink tcp/timers if needed, and ensure `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range` is wide (`10240 65535`). apply via DaemonSet sysctl.
kai: plan: canary sysctl bump on 3 eu-west edge nodes, watch conntrack count + CoreDNS response latency + failed pod connections. will also check iptables vs ipvs kube-proxy mode.
lisa: also consider NodeLocal DNS cache to reduce CoreDNS queries while we fix NAT pressure; but agree root cause is ephemeral port exhaustion.
amy: created runbook PR with steps to bump conntrack, add monitoring, and rollback. tagging @oncall for visibility.
pranav: note — updating `nf_conntrack_max` via sysctl is live; module reinit not required. but monitor memory — conntrack table grows.
kai: if canary looks good we'll roll to remaining edge nodes and follow up with adding an egress NAT gateway pool (to avoid host-level port limitations) and revisit probe timeouts for endpoints.
lisa: sounds good. will follow the PR and help with NodeLocalDNS test.
amy: :thumbsup: thanks all. leaving here for post-rollout stats.
